mapper.insert: INSERT INTO routine (user_UN, title, description, time, repeat_days, repeat_type, routine_type, target_value, current_value, is_active) VALUES (#{user_UN}, #{title}, #{description}, #{time}, #{repeat_days}, #{repeat_type}, #{routine_type}, #{target_value}, #{current_value}, #{is_active})
